annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2016/1628 on requirements relating to gaseous and particulate pollutant emission limits and type-approval for internal combustion engines for non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2016/1628 on requirements relating to gaseous and particulate pollutant emission limits and type-approval for internal combustion engines for non-road mobile machinery
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 252/53
annotation.summary_en: EU Regulation 2016/1628 sets Stage V gaseous and particulate pollutant emission limits and EU type-approval and market surveillance rules for internal combustion engines in non-road mobile machinery, replacing Directive 97/68/EC. It is not about AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Stage V emission limits for engines in non-road mobile machinery
EU type-approval, conformity of production and market surveillance procedures
Obligations for manufacturers, importers, distributors and OEMs
Prohibition of defeat strategies and tampering with emission controls
Repeals Directive 97/68/EC; Commission empowered to adopt delegated and implementing acts
